profile.headline: Seeking Full Stack Engineering Roles | Javascript | Typescript | React | Node.js
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with specialties developing in JavaScript (TypeScript), React, Redux, Node, Express, and SQL/NoSQL databases.  Most recently I co-founded a product called DenoGres (open source), an object relational mapper built for PostgreSQL for use on the Deno runtime. 

My variety of technical and cross-functional experiences have equipped me with a unique set of perspectives as well as a fortitude for facing some of the toughest challenges that companies face.  

During my tenure, I led the end-to-end implementation of a new financial ERP system over a three month time span, drafting user stories, implementing and ultimately testing over 75 features during that time period. I've led strategic planning for multiple C-suite executives (CFO, COO, Chief People Officer).
 
Always looking to grow my professional network. Feel free to connect via LinkedIn. You can also find me on Github at: https://github.com/anthonylo87

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Orange County, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developed a comprehensive mortgage servicer and tenant tracking dashboard incorporating credit data integration and credit report tracking using PrimeReact and custom React components
• Utilized React and ApexCharts to build custom data visualizations, leveraging PrimeReact Components to maintain a consistent UI theme and allowing for ease of development
• Employed React Router to generate static routes for a single page application, allowing for dynamic content updates while minimizing server calls
• Implemented tenant/credit agency components utilizing React-hook-forms/Formik to ensure seamless data tracking/validation
• Leveraged AWS Cognito/Amplitude components to utilize “plug and play” authentication flows and user directories

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a comprehensive ORM library for the Deno runtime (Node.js), translating database schema tables and querying functionality into class-based models/methods, allowing users to fully interact with SQL within an object oriented paradigm
• Constructed a graphical interface using React and Tailwind, optimizing application performance through just-in-time server side rendering and employing island architecture to isolate client side rendering to strictly interactive components
• Architected an algorithm to parse and pre-validate user queries (evaluating syntax for errors, ensuring that the database schema is consistent with methods called by the user query and reducing server requests
• Constructed an API leveraging Express-like middleware to generate database schema models/methods and execute queries
• Employed Typescript to introduce static typing, improving codebase quality by flagging type-related errors during development cycle
• Implemented JWT to manage authorization, persisting user access credentials while reducing server load
• Leveraged Deno’s native testing framework to develop unit tests, ensuring continuous validation and increasing fault tolerance
• Product built under the OSLabs Tech Accelerator (opensourcelabs.io)
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Fresh.js · Node.js · Deno · Express.js · Representational State Transfer (REST) · PostgreSQL · React.js · Databases · Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer | Spotify Playlist Generator | Generating custom playlists within Spotify
positions.description:
• Incorporated third-party API integration and audio feature endpoints into a custom algorithm to generate curated content recommendations based on evolving user preferences
• Leveraged Material-UI components in conjunction with Chart.js to establish a consistent, uniformly styled front end interface, utilizing data visualizations to represent changes in playlist audio features over time

positions.title: Software Engineer | Scrum Tracker | Project management tool to manage project tasks
positions.description:
• Built a Node.js/Express server, establishing dynamic server-side request routing and employing middleware to handle HTTP requests
• Architected PostgreSQL database to maintain ACID compliance and ensure a stable, scalable data store for user and project data

positions.title: Software Engineer | Pair Programming Tool | Platform to network together with other engineers
positions.description:
• Created an application using React, leveraging React’s component-based architecture and virtual DOM to build a complex, stateful front end while maintaining performance through selective component rendering
• Implemented Redux as a scalable, centralized state management solution, improving code efficacy by minimizing prop-drilling

positions.title: Sr. Analyst/BI Developer
positions.description:
• Served as finance lead on regional strategic planning/business intelligence initiatives for C-suite (CFO, COO, Chief People Officer)
• Collaborated with IT to implement ETL process into AWS Redshift (~50K+ transactions/month)
• Collected data from Azure SQL data warehouse, created Power BI data models, and summarized data into KPI dashboards tracking project and office level financial metrics (~450M+ revenue annually)
• Led the end-to-end implementation and transition to a new financial ERP system (Anaplan) (50+ active users)
• Consolidated business requirements into user stories and implemented 75+ features/modules in a three month span
• Initiated mentorship sessions for 5 junior analysts on extracting data from AWS Redshift and Tableau dashboard design
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure SQL · Tableau · Amazon Redshift · PowerBI
